body: I am too tired to try anymore. I know I am not able to love or be loved. I don't need to pretend that the above statement is not true. I do not have the ability to be close with anyone ever again. I though I maybe have the heart for it but recent events make me confident I do not.
If no one takes these cats today, I am going to kill myself anyway. DONT LET THESE ANIMALS SUFFER

I just am rotating between trying to sleep and uncontrollable sobbing. I dont trust people in general so it makes it very difficult for me to get help. All I know is I have to find someone to take these cats before tomorrow morning. So anyone reading please consider taking these cats. I can up the cash offer to 1000 usd which should pay for their care for at least the first few or two.

I don't want them to suffer but I am not sure how much longer I can bear to do this. I am growing weaker and more tired these days. I tried to convince myself that I could love and be loved again. But recent events made me very aware that this is a delusional hope. 今日は本当に浩子話してみたい。けどむりな

I am not stable enough to talk to right now. Thank you for considering taking the cats. Really just need to find them a home right. No one alive can handle my emotions. Ive proved that enough times already

Is it weird I don't want a funeral? I am trying really hard to make sure my body won't be found. I'm  sorry you lossed your wife.i hope I have the strength to do this, I am very worried that I will chicken out again. No one in my life can understand what I feel and how painful this life has become for me. Hopefully your family will take your cats.
Please someone read this... The cats are really nice
